body:
This PR updates clearAll to match our is.css specification.

**Things done**

 - update name: clearAll -> clearRefinements
 - rename excludeAttributes -> excludedAttributes
 - update template keys
 - update css classes keys

It also adds

 - capability to pass an IS configuration in dev-novel for connector stories

**Notes**

 - since the implementation is based on a button instead of a link, it simplifies the implementation of the component

**Test**

 - [component](https://deploy-preview-3114--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/dev-novel/?selectedStory=ClearRefinements.default)
 - [connector](https://deploy-preview-3114--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/dev-novel/?widgets=jquery&selectedStory=ClearAll.default)
